notifyConfig.title: Async Notify Config
notifyConfig.infoBanner: Async notify config receives business event callbacks pushed by the platform. Please fill in a callback URL (http/https) accessible from the public network
notifyConfig.notifyUrlTooltip: Event notifications will be pushed to this URL via HTTP POST, supports http/https protocol
notifyConfig.notifyWayHint: Choose how to receive notifications (HTTP callback or MQ push)
notifyConfig.subscribedEventsTooltip: Select the business event types you want to receive
notifyConfig.notifyUrlInvalid: Invalid callback URL format, must start with http:// or https://
notifyConfig.mqTopicHint: The platform publishes notifications to this app-isolated topic; consume via a JMS durable subscriber (no message loss when offline)
